requirements.quote:
When a BGP speaker receives an UPDATE message from an internal peer,
   the receiving BGP speaker SHALL NOT re-distribute the routing
   information contained in that UPDATE message to other internal peers
   (unless the speaker acts as a BGP Route Reflector [RFC2796]).
requirements.condition: A BGP speaker receives an UPDATE from an internal peer and is not acting as a BGP Route Reflector.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: SHALL NOT redistribute the routing information in that UPDATE to other internal peers.
requirements.why_checkable: Internal-peer input can be followed to outbound advertisements to verify the redistribution restriction and reflector exception.

requirements.quote:
As part of Phase 3 of the route selection process, the BGP speaker
   has updated its Adj-RIBs-Out.  All newly installed routes and all
   newly unfeasible routes for which there is no replacement route SHALL
   be advertised to its peers by means of an UPDATE message.
requirements.condition: Phase 3 has updated Adj-RIBs-Out with newly installed routes.
requirements.required_behavior: SHALL advertise all newly installed routes to its peers by means of an UPDATE message.
requirements.why_checkable: New Adj-RIB-Out entries can be compared with the resulting outbound UPDATE messages.

requirements.quote:
As part of Phase 3 of the route selection process, the BGP speaker
   has updated its Adj-RIBs-Out.  All newly installed routes and all
   newly unfeasible routes for which there is no replacement route SHALL
   be advertised to its peers by means of an UPDATE message.
requirements.condition: Phase 3 has updated Adj-RIBs-Out with newly unfeasible routes for which there is no replacement route.
requirements.required_behavior: SHALL advertise all such newly unfeasible routes to its peers by means of an UPDATE message.
requirements.why_checkable: Route loss without replacement can be correlated with outbound withdrawal UPDATE messages.

requirements.quote:
A BGP speaker SHOULD NOT advertise a given feasible BGP route from
   its Adj-RIB-Out if it would produce an UPDATE message containing the
   same BGP route as was previously advertised.
requirements.condition: Advertising a given feasible BGP route from Adj-RIB-Out would produce an UPDATE containing the same BGP route as previously advertised.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: SHOULD NOT advertise that feasible BGP route again.
requirements.why_checkable: Previously advertised route state and unchanged-route suppression can be inspected and exercised.

requirements.quote:
Any routes in the Loc-RIB marked as unfeasible SHALL be removed.
   Changes to the reachable destinations within its own autonomous
   system SHALL also be advertised in an UPDATE message.
requirements.condition: Routes in the Loc-RIB are marked as unfeasible.
requirements.required_behavior: SHALL remove every such route from the Loc-RIB.
requirements.why_checkable: Marking a Loc-RIB route unfeasible permits checking that its entry is removed.

requirements.quote:
Any routes in the Loc-RIB marked as unfeasible SHALL be removed.
   Changes to the reachable destinations within its own autonomous
   system SHALL also be advertised in an UPDATE message.
requirements.condition: Reachable destinations within the BGP speaker's own autonomous system change.
requirements.required_behavior: SHALL advertise those changes in an UPDATE message.
requirements.why_checkable: A change to local-AS destination reachability can be matched to outbound UPDATE content.

requirements.quote:
If, due to the limits on the maximum size of an UPDATE message (see
   Section 4), a single route doesn't fit into the message, the BGP
   speaker MUST not advertise the route to its peers and MAY choose to
   log an error locally.
requirements.condition: A single route does not fit into an UPDATE because of the maximum UPDATE message size limit.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: MUST NOT advertise that route to its peers.
requirements.why_checkable: A route whose encoded UPDATE exceeds the maximum size can be used to check advertisement suppression.

requirements.quote:
If, due to the limits on the maximum size of an UPDATE message (see
   Section 4), a single route doesn't fit into the message, the BGP
   speaker MUST not advertise the route to its peers and MAY choose to
   log an error locally.
requirements.condition: A single route does not fit into an UPDATE because of the maximum UPDATE message size limit.
requirements.required_behavior: MAY choose to log an error locally.
requirements.why_checkable: The oversized-route handling branch can optionally emit a local error log; absence of a log is also permitted.
